explanation: Input file generated for eta electroproduction at (W=1.4885 GeV, Q²=0.5 GeV², cos θ*=0.2, φ*=60°) using CLAS12 defaults: beam momentum 6.53 GeV, inelasticity cut 0.166 GeV², EtaMAID model. WARNING: This kinematic point is only ~2.5 MeV above the η production threshold (Wth≈1.486 GeV). The available phase space for the recoiling proton is extremely small (vmax≈0.007 GeV²), which may cause slow convergence or numerical challenges in the Monte Carlo integration over inelasticity. The calculation is physically valid but marginal. For robustness, consider using the unphysical-skip runner mentioned in the README if integrating over threshold grids. The output will contain radiative corrections (δ=σobs/σ0) and amplitude ratios for both unpolarized and polarized cross sections.
